paragraphs: Political: "Switzerland Debates Longstanding Neutrality Ahead of Vote This Month" (Bloomberg) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Committee calls for bill to address AI threat to human rights" (BBC News).

Economic: "One Nation vows to cut migration by 750,000 amid warnings move would damage economy" (The Guardian) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Copper Slips as Inflation Data Raises Bets on Fed Hiking Rates" (Bloomberg).

Financial: "Pakistan's GasPort on LNG Outlook Amid Hormuz Closure" (Bloomberg) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Stock market holiday today: NSE, BSE closed on September 14 for Ganesh Chaturthi; trading resumes Tuesday | India News" (Hindustan Times).

Geopolitical: "Politics live: petrol prices set to rise ‘even higher’; Labor’s private health reform for over-65s condemned as ‘lazy’" (The Guardian) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station" (BBC News).
